entries.source: Once the nervous system of the Maggot, it transformed into something... else after the Maggot ate some remains of a long dead god. If severed the Godfeaster will surely wither and die.
entries.target: 这曾经是巨大蛆虫的神经系统，在蛆虫吃下某个死去已久的古神的部分残骸之后，它变成了某种……别的东西。如果将其切断，噬神者必将枯萎死去。
这个勇敢的冒险家救了你。

entries.source: #OLIVE_DRAB#You can feel tremors in the worm.. A gastric wave is coming! Dodge to an alcove!
entries.target: #OLIVE_DRAB#你能感觉到虫子在颤抖……一波胃液来了！躲进凹室！
通向克诺什库尔的传送门

entries.source: One of the centers of the nervous system of the Maggot, if severed the Maggot will surely wither and die.
entries.target: 巨大蛆虫的神经中枢。如果将其摧毁，巨大蛆虫也会死去。

entries.source: A grim looking necromancer vampire. It seems to be draining the krogs of their life force for some nefarious purpose.
entries.target: 一个冷酷的吸血鬼死灵法师。他似乎正在吸取克罗格的生命能量，以达成某种邪恶的目的。

entries.source: You can hardly believe your eyes, standing in from of you as the grand master of the necromancers is a lich.
entries.target: 你不敢相信你的眼睛，在你面前死灵法师们的领袖竟然是一个巫妖。

entries.source: How this giant, this force of Nature has been captured and subdued is proof that the necromancers are not to be treated lightly.
entries.target: 这位巨人，这股自然力量的化身，竟然被人抓获并制服。显然，死灵法师们的力量不能轻视。

entries.source: The bottom part of Telos' broken staff.
entries.target: 泰勒斯折断法杖的下半部。

entries.source: The cultists are about to sacrifice the woman. Stop them!
entries.target: 邪教徒准备献祭那个女人。阻止他们！

entries.source: The foul stench of rotten ichor and undeath hangs over this place. There is necromancy at work here. As you listen more closely, you can hear anguished bellows coming from further inside the lair. There's a certain rough and deep timbre to the voice, sounding like a mix of a dragon's roar and a giant's rumblings. That could be none other than the Krogs you came to rescue. You do not know what experiments the necromancers are performing on them, but you're certain that you need to stop them before they succeed.
entries.target: 腐烂的灵液与不死的气息笼罩着此地。这里一定是某种死灵仪式的现场。当你更仔细地倾听时，你听到巢穴更深处传来充满痛苦的嘶吼。声音粗野而深沉，仿佛是龙的吼声与巨人咆哮混合在一起，这正是你要拯救的克罗格的声音。你并不明白死灵法师要在他们身上做什么实验，但你知道，自己一定要在实验成功前阻止他们。

entries.source: The captive krogs are no longer protected in their time prisons are very vulnerable!
entries.target: 克罗格身上的时间牢笼被解除了，它们现在非常脆弱！
奇怪的设备活动起来了。

entries.source: #CRIMSON#The ground shakes as you finish the glyph sequence %s%s%s%s!
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你完成了印记序列%s%s%s%s，地面震动了起来！

entries.source: One of the tentacle tree has awakened!
entries.target: 其中一棵触手树活起来了！

entries.source: Kroltar, the mightiest fire wyrm to have ever walked Eyal. It was said that a group of dwarves had slain him, but something has taken up residence in the once proud creature's body, reanimating it into a twisted new lifeform.
entries.target: 库洛塔，埃亚尔历史上最为伟大的火龙。传说矮人远征队杀死了他，不过另外一些东西似乎占据了这个曾经骄傲的巨龙的躯体，使其复苏成了一种扭曲的新生命形态。

entries.source: and fed to the corrupt writhing tentacles
entries.target: 并将其喂给了腐化的扭动触手

entries.source: #YELLOW_GREEN#One of the trees shakes for a moment and awakens!
A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
entries.target: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

entries.source: A tall elf, his skin covered in green moss.
entries.target: 一名高大的精灵，他的皮肤覆有青苔。
